featured_reviews.name: zohair chinwala
featured_reviews.review_text: I joined Behzaad Fitness as a new year resolution for getting back to some exercise. So on January 1, I went for a free trial session of Tabata. I was very impressed with the trial and signed up with them the same day. Since then I have been going regularly for these classes and I am quite sure ill continue going. The exercise format seems to be well thought of and they limit each session to a maximum of 8 people. This ensures that everyone gets attention, it's like having your own personal trainer who is guiding you with your exercises. What was interesting was the kind of bond the people exercising had with each other. Even though I was new to this group, it just took a few days to get familiar and comfortable with the other members. It is like one big family. Maybe that is why their whatsapp group is called One Tabata Family.
